sections.title: Ye company kya karti hai?
sections.content: Futurice Nordic consultancy hai — enterprise clients ke liye product, design, engineering, transformation; studios Finland se Switzerland tak, client work ke saath internal ventures bhi.

sections.title: Customers kaun hain?
sections.content: Enterprise aur mid-market orgs digital transformation mein. Finance, retail, media, public sector, industrial — product innovation dhundhte hain, commodity delivery nahi.

sections.title: Products / services kya hain?
sections.content: Product strategy, service design, custom software, data/AI, cloud engineering, change support. Internal ventures aur open-source bhi.

sections.title: Business model kya hai?
sections.content: Consulting engagements, multi-disciplinary teams, long-term innovation partnerships. Relationship + expertise led — SaaS-first nahi.

sections.title: Recent kya matter karta hai?
sections.content: AI-native delivery, responsible AI, practical enterprise transformation pe zyada focus. GenAI + product discovery + engineering + change management combine ho raha hai.

sections.title: Hiring patterns kya dikhte hain?
sections.content: Product, engineering, design, data/AI, consulting roles Europe mein active. Cross-functional teams pe invest — narrow silos nahi.

sections.title: Strategic challenges kya ho sakte hain?
sections.content: Bespoke consulting margins vs faster repeatable AI offerings balance karna. Clients ko innovation theater se durable capability chahiye — strategy, product, delivery connect chahiye.

sections.title: AJ yahan value kaise create kar sakta hai?
preview: Yahan multipotentialite survive karta hai — silos kam, ambiguous work zyada
Client ko innovation theater se durable capability chahiye — tum bridge ho
AI transformation ko teachable method banao — strategy se delivery tak
sections.content: Futurice pe AJ connective strategist ban sakta hai: client mandates ambiguous hain, silos kam hain. Woh AI ambition ko slides se production tak le jaane wale methods design kar sakta hai — education, work, wellbeing themes ko enterprise transformation se jod kar.

sections.title: Entry points (job nahi — opportunity creation)
sections.content: Ye job applications nahi — collaboration ke raste hain.
items: Enterprise clients ke AI transformation portfolios pe advisor
8-12 week Innovation Partner in Residence sprint
Education + future of work pe repeatable innovation methods
AI ambition ko practical product systems workshop
Internal team ke saath cross-sector venture pilot
Talks, playbooks, open methods for multipotentialite operators
